input_types: UTF-8 JSON stdin request matching ignition/schemas/operations/declared-permission-delta-r0.schema.json: two declared grant snapshots with the same policy_id and subject_id.
required_outputs: Exact string-set differences listing caller-declared (capability, scope) grants added to and removed from the candidate snapshot.
Review-required status and explicit source-authenticity, effective-policy, enforcement, permission-grant, and Owner-authorization ceilings.
